title: Evidence executor manifests
description: provenance/executor-manifests.json in an evidence/v1 export (spec 1.1.0): the ExecutorManifest documents when the executor_ids of the chain name two or more manifests. With exactly one digest named the export carries provenance/executor-manifest.json instead, and the two files are never both present. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; the sha256 of the canonical form of each element is a digest that some executor_id names after the at sign, each digest appears once, and every digest named appears; the name of each element is the name before the at sign in every executor_id that names it; at least 1 and at most 16 elements; the file is at most 1 MiB. The order of the elements (an exporter writes them by digest) is not checked.

export_version.description: The export layout version; 1 in evidence/v1.

items.description: One ExecutorManifest document in canonical form, as provenance/executor-manifest.json holds it.
